flows.result: Trusted host actor and source patient/resource/service data
Patient and resource detail URLs survive refresh with actual identifiers
Named shared registration drawer is visible and closes on Escape
Typed patient registration persists and opens its durable record
Shared header lookup selects an API patient by keyboard
Patient keyboard selection, service, real availability, visit details and booking
Booking replays once; overlapping booking and changed-payload key reuse are refused
Confirmation persists through the appointment drawer
Shared modal changes appointment duration with server resource checks
Move to an available slot retains the old booking as rescheduled
Cancellation records its reason and keeps the booking history
Resource weekly schedule uses the unchanged command envelope and persists
Booking lifecycle is audited and simulated notification records remain available
Scheduler admin restrictions, assigned-provider calendar/record scope, disabled module login and branch isolation
Mounted registration survives Arabic RTL, Hindi, Malayalam and English with effective compact density, reduced motion and disabled shortcuts

scope: Local browser against the unchanged synthetic demo HTTP API
